info.title: Inventory & Warehouse System API
info.description: REST API for the Inventory & Warehouse System

message.description: Human-readable message, or an array of validation messages for 400s.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the error was produced.

path.description: Request path that produced the error.

Role.description: Role; defaults to STAFF when omitted.

role.description: Role; defaults to STAFF when omitted.

warehouseIds.description: Full set of warehouse ids the user is scoped to (replaces existing).

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT for the Authorization header.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived JWT used to rotate the pair at /auth/refresh.

userIds.description: User ids to assign as staff/managers of this warehouse.

parentId.description: Parent category id (UUID), or null for a root category.
Parent category id (UUID) for nesting; omit for a root category.
Parent category id (UUID) for nesting; omit for a root category.

costPrice.description: Cost price as a decimal string (never a float).

sellingPrice.description: Selling price as a decimal string.

total.description: Total on hand = available + reserved + damaged + inTransit.

lowStock.description: True when available is at or below the reorder level (server-computed).

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id (UUID) — must be within your scope.

delta.description: Signed change to apply to the bucket (e.g. +5 to add, -3 to remove). Must be non-zero and may not drive the bucket below zero.

reason.description: Reason for the adjustment (required — audit trail).

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id (UUID) — must be within your scope.

quantity.description: Units to move from available to reserved. Must not exceed available.

reason.description: Optional note describing what the stock is reserved for.

availableDelta.description: Signed change to the available bucket.

reservedDelta.description: Signed change to the reserved bucket.

damagedDelta.description: Signed change to the damaged bucket.

inTransitDelta.description: Signed change to the in-transit bucket.

beforeQty.description: Total on hand before the movement.

afterQty.description: Total on hand after the movement.

refType.description: Source document type (e.g. PO, TRANSFER, COUNT).

unitsOrdered.description: Total units ordered across all lines.

quantityAccuracy.description: Sound units received ÷ units ordered, as a 0–1 ratio (null if nothing ordered).

damageRate.description: Damaged ÷ (sound + damaged) received, 0–1 (null if nothing received).

onTimeRate.description: Completed orders received on/before expectedDate ÷ completed orders with an expectedDate, 0–1 (null if none).

unitCost.description: Unit cost as a decimal string.

outstandingQty.description: Ordered minus received (sound). Never below zero.

totalCost.description: Total ordered value = Σ(quantity × unitCost), decimal string.

warehouseId.description: Destination warehouse id (UUID) — must be in your scope.

lines.description: Replacement set of order lines (replaces all existing lines).

productId.description: Product id (UUID) — must belong to the PO.

resultingPoStatus.description: PO status after this receipt was applied.

sourceWarehouseId.description: Source warehouse id (UUID) — must be in your scope.

variance.description: counted − recorded (null until counted). Positive = surplus, negative = shrinkage.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id (UUID) to count — must be in your scope.

productId.description: Product id (UUID) — must be a line on this count.

units.description: Available units across the caller scope.

value.description: Stock value (units × cost price), decimal string.

totalStockUnits.description: Total on-hand units across the caller scope (all buckets).

stockValue.description: Stock value = Σ(available × cost price), decimal string.

rows.description: Row objects keyed by column key (string | number values).

dailyConsumption.description: Avg daily consumption over the lookback window.

daysToStockout.description: Projected days until available hits zero (null if no consumption).

warehouseId.description: Limit to one warehouse (must be in scope).

projectedStockoutDate.description: Projected stock-out date (null if no consumption).

lookbackDays.description: Lookback window used for the moving average (days).

configured.description: Whether an LLM provider is configured.

sources.description: Retrieved source records cited by the answer.

llmEnhanced.description: LLM-enhanced when a provider is configured; otherwise a deterministic template over the report figures.

summary.description: Plain-language summary, accurate to the figures.

figures.description: The figures the summary is derived from.

warehouseId.description: Restrict to one warehouse (must be in scope).

reason.example: No prior supplier on record — assign a supplier and create the PO manually.

created.description: Draft POs created for review (grouped by supplier × warehouse). Nothing is sent automatically.

skipped.description: Reorder lines that could not be auto-assigned a supplier.
